# TASTE The Show — full site text

> TASTE The Show is a Las Vegas pole, burlesque, contortion and variety show created and produced by Fawnia Mondey, performed at Gipsy Nightclub, 4605 Paradise Rd, Las Vegas, NV 89169. Three shows in 2027: Wednesday January 20, Wednesday May 19 and Wednesday September 15. Doors 7:00 PM, show 8:00 PM – 9:30 PM. Tickets are sold by Gipsy Nightclub (coming soon).

Website: https://tastetheshow.com/
Instagram: @tastetheshow — https://www.instagram.com/tastetheshow/

## The show

Fawnia Mondey presents TASTE: Pole · Burlesque · Contortion · Variety.

TASTE returns to the stage in 2027 with three bigger, bolder, unforgettable shows celebrating pole dance and performance arts in all forms.

Created and produced by Fawnia Mondey — world-renowned pole icon and owner of Pole Fitness Studio — TASTE is more than just a show. It's an experience.

Step into a world where artistry, movement and pure entertainment collide. TASTE is returning to the stage in 2027 with three bigger, bolder, unforgettable shows celebrating pole dance and performance arts in all forms — at the beautiful, upscale Gipsy Nightclub.

The acts:

1. Sensual Pole — strength, grace and seduction, suspended in mid-air.
2. Sizzling Burlesque — classic tease with a modern Vegas edge.
3. Contortion & Acro — gravity-defying feats that bend belief.
4. Dance & Variety — electrifying stage moments, back to back.

The show also features a host/emcee who works the crowd all night.

## The night

- 7:00 PM — Doors. Grab a drink, find your seat, soak up the room.
- 8:00 PM — Showtime. Lights down. Pole, burlesque, contortion, dance.
- 9:30 PM — Encore. Finale, photos and a night you'll be talking about.
- Tip your faves — bring tipping money; change is available.

## The venue

All three 2027 shows take the stage at the beautiful, upscale Gipsy Nightclub, 4605 Paradise Rd, Las Vegas, NV 89169. Doors 7:00 PM, show 8:00 PM, ends around 9:30 PM.

## FAQ

**Should I bring cash?**
Yes — bring your tipping money! Show your favorite performers some love. And don't worry, we'll make change for you.

**What time should I arrive?**
Doors open at 7:00 PM and the show starts at 8:00 PM. Come early to grab a drink and settle in before the lights go down.

**Where do I buy tickets?**
Tickets are sold by Gipsy Nightclub. Pick your show and choose General Admission, VIP or Table — you'll go straight to Gipsy's ticket page to check out (ticket links are coming soon).

**What's the difference between GA, VIP and a table?**
General Admission gets you in with open seating. VIP puts you in premium seats close to the stage. A table reserves a spot for your whole group.

**I have a question about my tickets.**
Tickets are handled by Gipsy Nightclub, so check your Gipsy confirmation email or contact Gipsy directly for changes, refunds or lost tickets.

**Who is behind TASTE?**
TASTE is created and produced by Fawnia Mondey — world-renowned pole icon and owner of Pole Fitness Studio, Las Vegas' legendary pole & aerial studio.

## Friends of TASTE

TASTE is part of a whole world of pole, burlesque and community in Las Vegas. Take a class, book the party, or give back.

- The Melissa Foundation (https://themelissafoundation.org) — Nonprofit. A 501(c)(3) empowering people with knowledge, resources and support to make healthier choices before, during and after cancer.
- Pole Fitness Studio (https://polefitnessstudio.com) — Classes · Parties. Las Vegas' legendary pole & aerial studio — 400+ beginner-friendly classes a month, bachelorette parties and instructor certification.
- Pole Fitness Online (https://www.polefitnessonline.com) — Online classes. Learn pole from home — live-streamed classes and an on-demand video library from Pole Fitness Studio.
- Officially Fawnia (https://officiallyfawnia.com) — The creator. Meet Fawnia Mondey — the pole dance pioneer and fitness model who taught the world's first pole class and created TASTE.
- Burlesque To Go (https://burlesquetogo.com) — Book performers. Burlesque dancers delivered to your party, event or suite anywhere in Las Vegas.
- Bachelorette Pole Dancing Parties (https://www.bachelorettepoledancingparties.com) — Parties. The ultimate Las Vegas bachelorette — a private pole dancing party for the bride and her crew.
- Las Vegas Pole Rentals (https://lasvegaspolerentals.com) — Rentals. Portable professional dance poles and stages delivered and set up at your home, suite or venue.
- I Love Pole Because (https://ilovepolebecause.com) — Community. Why do you love pole dancing? Real stories from the pole community — share yours.
